source: pokeemerald-expansion 1.17.1 (bb1093a7c) scripts, read 2026-10-16; re-check against the private engine with scripts/multiplayer/check_rival_catalogue.py --engine <checkout>
meaning: The save state the ORIGINAL game reaches at the end of LittlerootTown_ProfessorBirchsLab_EventScript_AgreeToSeeRival (starter received, Birch asks the player to go and see the rival on Route 103). The streamlined new-character flow applies these deltas after the engine's normal NewGameInitData (which already gives the money, the PC Potion and resets map flags) and after the existing character-selection, naming and 18-starter screens. Nothing later than this point is granted.
order: existing 18-starter selection (special ChooseStarter: writes VAR_STARTER_MON role and VAR_MULTIPLAYER_STARTER_CHOICE, gives the level-5 starter through ScriptGiveMon)
warp to the spawn tile; save once

set_flags.name: FLAG_SET_WALL_CLOCK
set_flags.from: PlayersHouse_2F_EventScript_WallClock (the engine must initialise the clock as StartWallClock would; the native build uses the host clock)

clear_flags.name: FLAG_HIDE_MAP_NAME_POPUP
clear_flags.from: every intro scene clears it at its end

items_note: The original introduction gives no items: the starter comes from Birch's bag, the money and the PC Potion from NewGameInitData. The Pokedex and 5 Poke Balls (lab, after Route 103) and the Running Shoes (Mom, armed by VAR_LITTLEROOT_TOWN_STATE 3, set with the Pokedex) are EARNED later and must not be granted.

male.note: the tile south of the player's house door (5,8); MB_NORMAL, collision 0

female.note: the tile south of the player's house door (14,8); MB_NORMAL, collision 0

starter.met_location: MAPSEC_ROUTE_101 (keep the original's summary text; ScriptGiveMon uses the current map, so the engine must set it explicitly when the flow runs elsewhere)
starter.nickname: optional: the original offers YES/NO in the lab (Common_EventScript_NameReceivedPartyMon); reuse the existing naming screen if offered

existing_characters: Never applied to a save that already has FLAG_SYS_POKEMON_GET or VAR_BIRCH_LAB_STATE >= 2 (an existing or partly played character); such saves keep their own state. Whether a character is new to a world is decided by the Update 30 character-loading system, not here.
